result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but the bottom navigation has a clear overlap defect: a dark bar sits on top of the search and saved icons. A minor contrast concern is also visible in the grey secondary text. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded as intended.

issues.description: A dark horizontal home-indicator bar is drawn over the bottom navigation, partially covering the search icon and overlapping the saved/bookmark icon. The nav icons look collided and the search tab is hard to see or tap.
issues.suggestion: Keep the system home indicator in its own safe-area inset below the navigation bar, and add bottom padding so the nav icons are fully visible and unobstructed.

issues.description: Secondary grey text (delivery fees such as '€0.90 delivery', and the review count '(500+)') appears light grey on white, which may not meet WCAG AA contrast for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the white background.
